summary: Implemented, preregistered and completed one bounded offline context-v2 LoRA pilot from fresh local Qwen3-4B-Base, using 192 unique fit-only examples at approximately natural joint-state proportions. Independently verified the request, all updates, saved/reloaded adapter, resources and unchanged source/input pins. This is a quarantined engineering pilot, not demonstrated trading improvement.

inputs.instrument: 6E futures auxiliary research signals for EUR/USD spot/CFD work
inputs.state_key: Characters encode the unchanged opportunity direction at 1/2/4 extra ticks: N neither, L long, S short.
inputs.quota_rule: Largest integer remainders of 192 times full-fit class count divided by 14670; fixed state-order ties. No minority minimum, oversampling, duplicate cases or class-loss weights.
inputs.quota_error: Every selected class count differs from its exact natural fractional quota by less than one case.
inputs.within_state_rule: Spread over fit sessions, then unique even within-session ranks; not an IID sample, and preserving joint proportions does not remove selection bias.
inputs.training_order: SHA256 of seed 42 and case_id; fixed independently of check labels.
inputs.causal_features: 43 current values and three past-only [count,span,ten snapshot means] arrays for 5/15/30 seconds; empty history explicit, no interpolation.
inputs.native_isolation: Selected train/inner-fit examples and asset/split/prior metadata only; no dataset, raw/dense history, check-example, CPU model or historical adapter paths.
inputs.unknown_outcomes: 6509 unavailable/uncertain eligible cases remain unknown and are not selected as negative labels.
inputs.target: Unchanged delayed-entry 15-second 6E crossed-quote class at 1/2/4 extra total round-trip ticks. Not broker fills, portfolio returns or PnL.

recipe.initialization: Fresh pinned local Qwen3-4B-Base and fresh q/v LoRA; rejected snapshot adapters never resumed.
recipe.dtype: CUDA BF16, deterministic algorithms, TF32 disabled
recipe.loss: Unweighted completion plus real EOS only; prompt and padding masked.

frozen_future_evaluation.scope: All original inner-check examples, not a selected subset.
frozen_future_evaluation.exposure: Already-exposed within-training temporal development, not an independent holdout.
frozen_future_evaluation.linear_specification: 79 numeric causal columns; normalize on all fit only, count/window plus span/means; natural unweighted 200-epoch cross entropy, learning rate 0.05, L2 0.01, clip 10, zero weights and Laplace-smoothed fit log priors. No class penalty or reweighting.
frozen_future_evaluation.decoding: Frozen greedy BF16 generation with existing 48-token cap; strict EOS, JSON fields/classes and cost monotonicity; no repairs or retries.
frozen_future_evaluation.metrics: Complete pooled and every-session support, coverage, per-cost confusion, directional precision/recall, wrong-side/no-opportunity calls, missed opportunities and activity. Invalid outputs incorrect, never relabeled abstention.
frozen_future_evaluation.implementation_status: Preregistered specification only; context-v2 full-check evaluator and numeric control runner are the next development step.

checks.initial_metadata_preflight: Refused a relative temporary validation path before registration creation or model loading. Fixed normalization, then completed all preparation checks; no native training retry.

safety.native_boundary: Owned bounded offline subprocess, local safetensors and pinned runtime. Not an OS sandbox or hard VRAM quota.
safety.latency_warning: No model decision latency, 100ms broker execution, CFD spread/fills, risk/PnL or live suitability demonstrated. A lower training loss is not predictive or trading validation.

next_step: Implement and test the preregistered context-v2 numeric controls and complete 5008-example inner-check comparison, then evaluate the fresh base and quarantined adapter on identical cases. No partial sample, repaired outputs or threshold search; no larger training or trading promotion based on this pilot.
